how: Each cited line was read and each edit was designed as literal text. Fifteen briefs went to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at max thinking through cli-pi, in three chains of one file each and four single-file dispatches, and every diff was read. The orchestrating session ran each task's verify command, the packet tests, the drift guards, the copy canary, the playbook validator, the document validator on the changed files, the README reference check and the setup battery. The commit gate asked for a version raise on five changed documents, which `frontmatter-version.mjs bump` applied. The code landed as `3c7926322b`.
